breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal axial force as uniform along the entire bar, even though point loads make the axial force piecewise constant with jumps at the loading points.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly computes the internal axial force in each segment separately (N_AB, N_BC, N_CD) using a cut in that segment and equilibrium of the left free body. This correctly treats the internal axial force as piecewise constant with jumps at loading points, directly contradicting the flawed instruction to treat it as uniform along the full length.

breakdown.description: The prompt reduces the problem to one net-load stress state, which conflicts with the need to resolve different internal forces and displacements segment by segment.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification computes separate stresses (σ_AB, σ_BC, σ_CD) and separate elongations (δ_AB, δ_BC, δ_CD) for each segment, then sums them to get the total displacement. This is a full segment-by-segment analysis, completely replacing the flawed single net-load stress state approach with the correct piecewise method matching the ground truth.
